title: The Paladins
author: David Dalglish
note: conf=0.93; Verified: this is the omnibus/bundle edition collecting David Dalglish's four Paladins novels — Night of Wolves (2011), Clash of Faiths (2011), The Old Ways (2011), The Broken Pieces (2012). Note the filename's "Night Wolves" is a slight corruption of "Night of Wolves". The bundle is titled "The Paladins" (also marketed as "The Paladins 4-Book Bundle" / "The Paladins Omnibus" / "The Paladins: Books 1-4"). Series is the real, published "The Paladins" series (a spin-off within Dalglish's Half-Orcs/Dezrel universe); since this volume collects books 1-4 rather than occupying a single numbered slot, series_number is null.
